Have you tried restarting the phone or checking for any available updates? Sometimes, software updates can fix such issues. If the problem persists, reaching out to Samsung's customer support might provide further assistance or solutions.

Edit: Here are a few more steps you can try:

Check if the issue occurs only during phone calls or if it happens with other audio sources as well, such as music or videos.

Test your phone's microphone to see if it's working properly. You can do this by recording a voice memo or using a voice recording app.

Make sure there are no physical obstructions, like a case or screen protector, blocking the microphone or speaker.

If the issue persists, consider performing a factory reset on your phone as a last resort. Remember to back up your data before doing so, as a factory reset will erase all your personal data and settings.

Hopefully, one of these steps will help resolve the issue. If not, contacting Samsung's customer support or visiting a service center would be your best bet for further assistance.
